reviews.text: Dr. Gargiulo, a wonderful professional, attentive, precise, prepared and always available.
I wouldn't change for anyone else

On February 16, 2006, I went to the clinic to have Honey, my cat, spayed. What can I say! Dr. Gargiulo and his staff were exceptional, as always. This is the third cat I've spayed; the other two were done at another clinic. I've seen a noticeable difference. Honey's procedure was less invasive; he came home that afternoon fully awake, lively as always, and perfectly medicated, as if he'd never done anything. They are very professional, and with four cats, I will definitely continue to use them. Thank you 🙏🏻
Professionalism and top-level services, you feel at ease and our 4-legged friend is at the centre of everything
Reliable veterinary clinic with honest prices!!!!!!

They examined my Minnie at the ripe old age of 18, and I had a great time. Today, they examined little Maia. Dr. Giorgia was so sweet, gentle, thorough, and helpful. When you find GOOD vets, it's best not to miss out!
Very prepared and professional, extremely attentive and helpful with the owners

I write this review with infinite gratitude. In a time of great grief, the staff at Prati Veterinary Clinic proved to be a beacon of kindness and compassion. They began the most beautiful adventure with my cat in 2014, when he weighed only 400 grams. They provided his first vaccinations, and yesterday they accompanied him through his final period and his final journey with a sensitivity and professionalism that deeply touched me. They handled the delicate situation with the utmost professionalism and humanity. I was able to say goodbye to my friend in a calm and respectful environment. Their expertise and empathy made a painful moment a little more bearable.

Thank you
Francesco (Maggie)
Excellent experience. Kindness, professionalism, empathy, you name it. Dr. Assin is a guarantee. Top!

Eleven weeks of appointment requests have gone unanswered. My dog ​​is still suffering. Five vets near Prati have been to him, and none have been available. This is just another one of them. I'm now moving to another area of ​​Rome. I hope things are better there. If you live near this vet, say a prayer to Saint Roche for help, as the outcome could be better. I wish you better luck than I have had.
